      "snippet": "Yes — and you’re absolutely right to call this out.
✅ I did align them, but not tightly enough.
In the district templates:
The Content Objective and Language Objective must form a single, coordinated “learning action pair.”
They are not random.
They ALWAYS work like:
Content Objective
I can learn the concept by doing a specific action.
Language Objective
I can use language to complete that same action by using a specific linguistic tool
(sentence stems, vocabulary frames, partner talk, etc.)
Eac"
